messages:
sara: kicking off a config-only canary now — tightening timeouts + per-tenant inflight limits. change window 03:30-04:30 UTC. command: `/deploy start config-only timeout-limiter-2026-03-22 --cohorts 4 --stagger 8m`

deploy-bot:  Started deploy `timeout-limiter-2026-03-22`
- mode: config-only
- cohorts: 4 (8m stagger)
- owner: sara

brad: what's the proto rollback plan? automatic aborts? manual? :eyes:

lina: suggest automatic abort if any of: p99 > baseline + 50ms for 5m, 5xx rate > 0.6% (3m), or model_fallbacks > 1% (5m). manual rollback for cost uptick > 6%.

sara: agree. also toggling deploy-bot's auto-abort flag. deploy-bot, enable auto-abort on thresholds.

deploy-bot: auto-abort enabled for this rollout.

claire: can we pre-pin top 10 tenants to legacy routing for cohort 1 and 2? keep them insulated while we watch the small tenants.
sara: yes — cohort mapping: c1=5% small, c2=15% small+mid pinned heavy tenants, c3=30% mid, c4=50% all (enterprises gated). pin-file in /runbooks/deploys/timeout-limiter/pins.csv

brad: post the config diff plz.

sara: config diff: ```yaml
timeouts_ms:
  request_timeout: 10000
  streaming_timeout: 9000
limits:
  inflight_per_tenant: 6
  inflight_global: 6000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 36
  max_tokens: 800
routing_policy:
  prefer_local_kv: true
  fallback_variant: stable-v2026-01
```

lina: small nit: increase streaming_timeout to 9500 for cohorts 1-2. saves some truncation risk.
sara: applied cohort overrides for 1-2. deploy-bot apply `streaming_timeout: 9500` to cohorts 1-2.

deploy-bot: override applied to cohorts 1-2. cohort 1 (5%) started at 03:30:12 UTC.

ops-bot: snapshotting logs and traces for cohort 1: https://logs.redwood/snapshots/timeout-limiter/3355004321/1

deploy-bot: cohort 1 stable after 8m: p99 +9ms, 5xx 0.03%, model_fallback 0.12%, cost +0.9% 

claire: warming kv-cache for pinned tenants in region us-west-1 now.

brad: seeing isolated p95 blips in apac-east. not widespread. hold on c3 until we confirm.
sara: hold c3. Lina please stage region-pin for apac-east: `/deploy edit-pin --region apac-east --variant stable-v2026-01` queued.

lina: staged but not activated.

ops-bot: alert: apac_east_p95 = baseline + 64ms over 6m. cohort 3 held.

claire: we did a small targeted kv-cache pre-warm and the p95 improved to baseline + 18ms after 10m. recommend proceed.

sara: proceeding with c3 at 03:54 UTC.

deploy-bot: cohort 3 started at 03:54:05 UTC (30% ramp).

deploy-bot: final cohort 4 (50%) started at 04:12:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout finished. final stats: p99 +22ms, 5xx 0.08%, model_fallback 0.3%, cost-per-token +3.4%. No auto-aborts triggered. :tada:

brad: nice. follow-ups: 1) add streaming_timeout recommendation per cohort, 2) include pin-file path in playbook, 3) bake kv-cache warmup into geo ramps.

sara: creating release notes and checklist: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/timeout-limiter-2026-03-22 

lina: I'll create a 1-hour follow-up canary next week with inflight_per_tenant=5 for a tiny subset.

claire: archived logs and sent to runbook. ops-bot attached snapshots.

sara: thanks. if anyone spots anything odd later, call it out in #eng-releases and ping me.

brad: ship it. :shipit:
